disclaimer.p1: This overview is a tool based on your registered information, receipts and the rule version MyCleaner has available for your country.
disclaimer.p2: It is not an automatic tax filing and does not replace advice from the relevant tax authority, an accountant, or another qualified advisor.
disclaimer.p3: Rules can change. Always verify the information before filing.

financePages.footerNote: Report for overview. Totals are always grouped per currency — we never combine DKK, EUR, GBP etc. in a single KPI. The MyCleaner platform facilitates contact between customers and independent providers and only invoices its own platform fee; the provider is solely responsible for customer invoicing and VAT settlement. A scheduled payout is not a guarantee of a specific banking time — when the amount is visible in the account depends on the payment provider and the provider's bank.
